title: Untitled: THE Arabians have several proverbial sayings…
text: THE Arabians have several proverbial sayings concerning pretended false friendships. Some are taken from a pool which is filled by sudden hasty showers, and is extremely grateful to a thirsty traveller, but so deceitful, that when he returns he finds it quite exhausted. In the same manner they compare a treacherous friend to a torrent, or land-flood, which is soon raised, and as soon disappears. CHAPPELOw.
